3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: A knock came on the door. Prime Minister Saltana and Supreme Wiseman Azmal had arrived.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: A lot had happened since I promised the Derdian and Morellan leaders that I would mediate between them. But I was still determined to find a solution.

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: They and a handful of their ministers joined myself and Laurento around the conference table.

10.speaker: Player_Romus
10.text: "I'd like to begin with a short prayer."

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: The Supreme Wiseman's eyes shone with delight. His Morellan counterpart crossed her arms impatiently.

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "Ladies, gentleman. Shall we get right to it?"

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "Thank you both for joining me. I am confident we can accomplish great things today."

17.speaker: Player_Romus
17.text: "As we gather today, I pray that we do not let our trivial differences blind us. For we are but one people, united by God's enduring love."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "O Divine Creator, bless this mediation table and all who are seated at it. Help them to open their hearts and minds."

19.speaker: Player_Romus
19.text: "Lord, guide me in my sacred duty of finding communion between the nations of the former Empire of Moridia, that we may come together against the greater powers who wish us harm."

22.speaker: Narrator
22.text: Azmal and Saltana looked at each other uneasily.

24.speaker: Narrator
24.text: Laurento tented his fingers on the table.

25.speaker: Narrator
25.text: He opened a folder and pulled out a map of Derdia, Rizia and Morella with a diagram drawn on it.

27.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
27.text: "Each year, a select number of Derdians with an appropriate prayer visa will be allowed into Morella via this specific channel. It includes the most important sanctuaries on the Golcondist pilgrimage route."

31.speaker: Player_Romus
31.text: "Rizia re-allowed Derdian Golcondists into our places of worship with no ill consequences."

32.speaker: Alma Saltana
32.text: "Rizia shares no borders with Derdia. The only reason you have not been overwhelmed by an influx of so-called pilgrims is because we have been holding them back."

36.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
36.text: "The route continues into Rizia, where Derdian pilgrims have been permitted for some time."

37.speaker: Narrator
37.text: The Supreme Wiseman leaned forward and scrutinized the map.

38.speaker: Jorga Azmal
38.text: "This route ends at Lauante. After which, I suppose, we are to march into the sea?"

39.speaker: Player_Romus
39.text: "You go home the way you came. It's not that difficult."

40.speaker: Player_Romus
40.text: "You may continue into Rizia, as long as you agree to respect our blasphemy law."

42.speaker: Player_Romus
42.text: "Not at all. I fully plan on allowing Golcondists to worship in Rizia as well."

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: Both Azmal and Saltana glowered at me. The Morellan prime minister cleared her throat.

44.speaker: Alma Saltana
44.text: "{RiziaDLCText.SaltanaToPlayer}, you cannot really expect Morella to allow in Golcondist pilgrims while barring them from your own sanctuaries."

45.speaker: Player_Romus
45.text: "Our Wruhecist community is larger than Morella's. There is greater potential for disruption."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I'm afraid revoking our blasphemy law is out of the question. The Wruhecist Sanctuary is very powerful in this country."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "Rizia is in the middle of a war. I don't want to make any sudden policy changes."

50.speaker: Jorga Azmal
50.text: "You will forgive me if I don't place much stock in your promises."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: Saltana looked at us both uneasily.

56.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
56.text: "We all know why we are here."

60.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
60.text: "Your countries have been engaged in border disputes for years. Rizia has promised to help you find a common solution."

61.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
61.text: "Rizia has formed energy partnerships with both of your countries. It would behoove us all to find a solution to your border disputes."

66.speaker: Jorga Azmal
66.text: "Rizia has proven itself an unreliable energy partner. Why should we trust you as a mediator?"

71.speaker: Alma Saltana
71.text: "Funny, Mr. Azmal. Rizia has failed to meet its energy promises to us as well."

72.speaker: Alma Saltana
72.text: "It seems we have one thing in common after all."

76.speaker: Alma Saltana
76.text: "Rizia has proven itself an unreliable energy partner. Why should we trust you as a mediator?"

77.speaker: Narrator
77.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Derdia_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Morella_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] >= 4)) == false)

81.speaker: Alma Saltana
81.text: "A pipeline runs between Derdia and Morella now. If these insurgencies continue, our economies and image will suffer."

82.speaker: Alma Saltana
82.text: "It is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."

84.speaker: Player_Romus
84.text: "Now is not the time to talk about the energy situation. You may bring it up with me later."

85.speaker: Player_Romus
85.text: "I am truly sorry that our conflict with Pales interfered with our promised energy deliveries. Once we have won, I will repay you triplefold."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "Our energy deliveries were impeded by circumstances beyond my control. I sincerely apologize for that."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "You have more than that in common. It was only a few generations ago that the Moridians were one people."

92.speaker: Jorga Azmal
92.text: "Precisely, Your Majesty. Which is why it is so ludicrous that Derdians are being denied entrance into Morella."

93.speaker: Player_Romus
93.text: "You don't have a choice, do you? It's Rizia or nobody."

102.speaker: Narrator
102.text: She looked over at Azmal. He reluctantly nodded.

105.speaker: Jorga Azmal
105.text: "Insurgencies! It's exactly that kind of language that has made me reluctant to deal with you, Madam Prime Minister."

106.speaker: Alma Saltana
106.text: "Are you sure it's my language you have a problem with, Mr. Azmal? Not the fact that I'm a woman who holds more power than you?"

107.speaker: Alma Saltana
107.text: "We would gladly welcome you if you behaved yourselves. Instead, we get raids, insurgencies..."

111.speaker: Alma Saltana
111.text: "Even if it's not currently in use, a pipeline runs between Derdia and Morella now. If these insurgencies continue, our economies and image will suffer."

112.speaker: Alma Saltana
112.text: "With or without a Rizian energy deal, it is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "You will address the Supreme Wiseman using his full title, Prime Minister Saltana."

116.speaker: Alma Saltana
116.text: "Forgive me, Your Majesty. But I am adamantly opposed to the intrusion of religion into statecraft."

117.speaker: Jorga Azmal
117.text: "And yet you cannot deny those who do believe in a higher power the right to worship as their ancestors have."

122.speaker: Player_Romus
122.text: "There's obviously only one way to solve this. A Duel of Generosity."

123.speaker: Narrator
123.text: Laurento turned pale. Saltana burst out laughing.

124.speaker: Alma Saltana
124.text: "A king who just married his daughter to his cousin is proposing a duel."

131.speaker: Alma Saltana
131.text: "A king who just married off his daughter to expand his territory is proposing a duel."

133.speaker: Alma Saltana
133.text: "I'm here to talk politics, gentleman. Not play some sort of... game of thrones."

134.speaker: Jorga Azmal
134.text: "A duel won't be necessary, Your Majesty."

135.speaker: Jorga Azmal
135.text: "This is a problem with an easy solution. Allow Derdian Golcondists the freedom to practice their religion."

136.speaker: Player_Romus
136.text: "Never mind the Prime Minister's language, Supreme Wiseman. You must admit that the violent conduct of your people at the Morellan border has not been justified."

140.speaker: Player_Romus
140.text: "Stop squabbling at once, both of you. Your conduct is befitting of kindergarteners, not world leaders."

141.speaker: Narrator
141.text: Both Saltana and Azmal looked down at the table.

146.speaker: Jorga Azmal
146.text: "You may both run godless countries yourselves."

147.speaker: Jorga Azmal
147.text: "You may not believe in God yourself, Ms. Saltana."

148.speaker: Player_Romus
148.text: "Is it the right to worship you are after, or is it Morella's resources? We have not forgotten the Meftiem invasion."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "The borders between Derdia and Morella were drawn only recently. They do feel rather arbitrary."

150.speaker: Alma Saltana
150.text: "And yet they are there for a reason."

151.speaker: Player_Romus
151.text: "What Derdians do hardly falls under the category of worship."

152.speaker: Jorga Azmal
152.text: "That was the work of rogue actors. And furthermore, it occurred long before my appointment as Supreme Wiseman."

153.speaker: Jorga Azmal
153.text: "You are still under the sway of your Grand Wiseman, I see. Even after having arrested him."

157.speaker: Jorga Azmal
157.text: "You are still under the sway of your Grand Wiseman, I see."

158.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
158.text: "Supreme Wiseman, Madam Prime Minister. This is the solution my department has devised for you."

159.speaker: Narrator
159.text: His finger traced a thick black line from the Derdian-Morellan border towards the Antacean coast.

160.speaker: Jorga Azmal
160.text: "If you don't mind, I would like to have more than a mere assurance from you before agreeing to anything."

161.speaker: Jorga Azmal
161.text: "Then I cannot agree to your plan."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "We're in a delicate situation with Wehlen at the moment. I don't want to make any sudden policy changes."

167.speaker: Alma Saltana
167.text: "If you believe disruption is a concern at all, then I cannot agree to this plan."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "So be it. I tried my best."

173.speaker: Player_Romus
173.text: "Wait. I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

174.speaker: Player_Romus
174.text: "Wait. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

178.speaker: Player_Romus
178.text: "There's nothing I can do. That was my kingdom's best effort."
178.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Sal_Arrested"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 4) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Resources_Authority"] >= 4) == false)

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "I don't have a Grand Wiseman to appease anymore. I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Very well. If it helps your nations get along, I will revoke Rizia's blasphemy law, effective immediately." [-4 Authority]

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Sorry. An assurance is all I can give you right now."

188.speaker: Jorga Azmal
188.text: "Then I cannot agree to this proposal."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "I don't like your attitude, Supreme Wiseman. I will promise you nothing."

191.speaker: Jorga Azmal
191.text: "How fortunate, Your Majesty. I knew you would see the light someday."

193.speaker: Jorga Azmal
193.text: "I am not certain I believe you, Your Majesty."

194.speaker: Alma Saltana
194.text: "Thank you anyway for your hard work, Mr. Esquibel. This corridor would have been an ideal compromise."

195.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
195.text: "Thank you, Madam Prime Minister. It may still be an option in the future, even if it is not possible today."

197.speaker: Alma Saltana
197.text: "How do we know the Derdians will stick to the route as they pass through Morella?"

204.speaker: Player_Romus
204.text: "I will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces to grant the pilgrims secure passage." [Manpower -250]

205.speaker: Player_Romus
205.text: "The Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security." [-1 Budget]

206.speaker: Player_Romus
206.text: "Whoever violates the agreement will face the most severe of consequences. My kingdom will make sure of it."

219.speaker: Jorga Azmal
219.text: "How do *we* know the Morellans will not attempt to block it?"

220.speaker: Jorga Azmal
220.text: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

224.speaker: Alma Saltana
224.text: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

231.speaker: Jorga Azmal
231.text: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

236.speaker: Alma Saltana
236.text: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

239.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
239.text: "Thank you both for your swift willingness to compromise."

240.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
240.text: "Such solutions always seem easy when it's a third party proposing them, don't they?"

253.speaker: Jorga Azmal
253.text: "I'm afraid that's not enough assurance for me."

258.speaker: Alma Saltana
258.text: "I think it's a fine plan. But it's not entirely up to me."

262.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
262.text: "We'll assemble a team from all three of our countries to begin the creation of the corridor."

263.speaker: Player_Romus
263.text: "Fine. We will send *two* army companies." [-500 Manpower]

264.speaker: Player_Romus
264.text: "Fine. We will pour twice as much funding into security as planned." [-2 Budget]

265.speaker: Player_Romus
265.text: "Fine. A company from the Rizian Armed Forces will be physically present to grant the pilgrims secure passage." [Manpower -250]

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "If you insist, the Kingdom of Rizia will pay for a small team of independent contractors to oversee the corridor's security." [-1 Budget]

267.speaker: Narrator
267.text: The two of them looked at each other. Each gave a short, approving nod.

270.speaker: Player_Romus
270.text: "In addition to the military reinforcements, we will contract a team of independent security officers." [-250 Manpower, -1 Budget]

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "In addition to the security firm, we ourselves will send a company from the Rizian Armed Forces." [-1 Budget, -250 Manpower]

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "You're just going to have to trust each other, aren't you?"

273.speaker: Narrator
273.text: The two of them looked at each other.

274.speaker: Jorga Azmal
274.text: "I should have known this would not be a serious plan."

276.speaker: Alma Saltana
276.text: "Even if the corridor ends at Rizia's holy sites..."

277.speaker: Player_Romus
277.text: "You really thought we could erase a century's worth of resentment in five minutes?"

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "If Morella and Derdia can come to a diplomatic agreement this quickly, I have high hopes for the Intermerkopum alliance."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "Prime Minister Saltana, I hope this means that I can count on your cooperation during the final MITZ vote."

308.speaker: Player_Romus
308.text: "The Lord has truly blessed us on this day. Rejoice!"

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "Thank you for your hard work, Laurento. This was truly a team effort."

320.speaker: Narrator
320.text: The two of them looked away from each other. Laurento attempted to mask his disappointment.

321.speaker: Player_Romus
321.text: "It's fine. We don't need Morella and Derdia to get along for the Intermerkopum alliance to work out."

328.speaker: Player_Romus
328.text: "Alas, the Lord has not blessed us on this day. Perhaps we did something to anger Him."

329.speaker: Player_Romus
329.text: "Prime Minister Saltana, I hope I can still count on your cooperation during the final MITZ vote."

330.speaker: Player_Romus
330.text: "Yes, thanks anyway, Laurento. This was a great idea."

334.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
334.text: "I must say it would have helped, Your Majesty."

337.speaker: Player_Romus
337.text: "No, wait. I do have one idea."

342.speaker: Player_Romus
342.text: "Suddenly the man who believes in an invisible person in the sky doesn't have faith in his own neighbor?"

346.speaker: Narrator
346.text: Azmal gasped indignantly. Saltana laughed out loud.

347.speaker: Player_Romus
347.text: "You must take a leap of faith, Supreme Wiseman. What would St. Wruhec have done?"

348.speaker: Jorga Azmal
348.text: "As Wruhec himself said, the firmest bridge of trust may still be eroded by the waters of deceit."

353.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
353.text: "We still have the Derdia-Wehlen mediations scheduled for today. Perhaps a short break?"

354.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
354.text: "We are finished here. I am truly sorry we were not able to help you."

355.speaker: Narrator
355.text: The Derdian Supreme Wiseman and Morellan prime minister rose and shook both of our hands.

356.speaker: Alma Saltana
356.text: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

358.speaker: Narrator
358.text: They and their entourages were escorted out of the suite.

359.speaker: Jorga Azmal
359.text: "Yes, thank you. I must clear my head of prejudice after what just occurred."

360.speaker: Narrator
360.text: The Morellan prime minister rose and shook our hands.

361.speaker: Alma Saltana
361.text: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

362.speaker: Narrator
362.text: She and her entourage were escorted out of the suite.

366.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
366.text: "We still have the Derdia-Wehlen mediations scheduled for today. Perhaps a short break?"

367.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
367.text: "I'd like to go over a detail or two about that first. I'll escort you to the door."

368.speaker: Narrator
368.text: She and her entourage followed him out of the suite.

369.speaker: Jorga Azmal
369.text: "Yes, thank you. This was surprisingly pleasant, but I do not expect our interaction with President Smolak to go as smoothly."

370.speaker: Narrator
370.text: The Morellan prime minister rose and shook our hands.

371.speaker: Alma Saltana
371.text: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

372.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
372.text: "We are finished here. I am happy Rizia was able to help you."

373.speaker: Narrator
373.text: The Morellan prime minister rose from her seat.

374.speaker: Alma Saltana
374.text: "I will see you in the Trade Zone next month."

378.speaker: Alma Saltana
378.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Derdia_Failed"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Diplomacy_EnergyCommitment_Morella_Failed"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Law_Monarchy_Absolute"] == true  and  (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_TyrantKing"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Country_QuelledProtests"] >= 4))

379.speaker: Alma Saltana
379.text: "We in Morella have been paying attention to Rizia's internal politics. Your increasingly authoritarian policies leave us wondering about your reliability as a mediator."

383.speaker: Player_Romus
383.text: "You don't have a choice, do you? It's Rizia or nobody."

384.speaker: Player_Romus
384.text: "Rizia has always been an absolute monarchy, Ms. Saltana. You just chose to ignore it when it suited you."

385.speaker: Player_Romus
385.text: "I hear your concerns, but they're not germane to today's conversation."

386.speaker: Player_Romus
386.text: "You have no idea what you're talking about. The people of my country enjoy a great many freedoms. More than Morella, in fact."

389.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
389.text: "Madam Prime Minister, whatever our internal situation, we remain committed to finding a diplomatic compromise between your country and Derdia. And we are willing to put our money where our mouth is, so to speak."

391.speaker: Alma Saltana
391.text: "No? I'd like to know just what kind of monarchy I'm dealing with."

392.speaker: Jorga Azmal
392.text: "Derdia appreciates that commitment, Mr. Esquibel. As well as your tough but fair treatment of dissenters."

398.speaker: Alma Saltana
398.text: "Derdia and Morella are now connected by an energy pipeline. If Derdians continue to violate our borders, the economies and our images of both nations will suffer."

399.speaker: Alma Saltana
399.text: "It is time we put an end to these insurgencies. Our international image has suffered enough."
